title: /model typed during a turn is deferred with no visible sign; the panel pops up unannounced when the turn ends
observed: kiln defect (UX). During a busy turn, typing '/model' + Enter cleared the input and showed nothing: no queued block (plain text and '!ls' do get a 'you · queued' block), no note. When the turn finished, the model panel opened over the transcript. /status and /mcp mid-turn ran immediately (good).
expected: Show the deferred command as queued (like a queued message), or say '/model will open when this turn ends'.
